events.name: Tucson Girls Chorus presents BREATH BECOMING: Sounds of Winter 2026
events.info: Now in our 41st season, the Tucson Girls Chorus is awake to the calling of newness and fearless in pursuing the heights of our potential. With each breath we invite together, we are becoming brighter and more brilliant, taking up space, and sustaining our movement of wonder and joy. Join us for BREATH BECOMING: Sounds of Winter 2026. featuring over 300 singers from 6-18, this special concert brings girls together on stage to share beautiful harmonies, cherished traditions, and the magic of becoming. Our breath brings us clarity: we are in the process of greatness!
